Set an Employee's Approvers

User manual · English · 6 steps
Learn how to choose who approves an employee's time off requests, by setting the approver on the employee record.

1. Open Employees

Open the Employees app.

2. Open an employee

Click an employee to open the record.

3. Work Information tab

Click the Work Information tab.

4. Time Off approver

Click the Time Off field to open the list of users.

5. Choose the approver

Click the user you want as approver.

6. Save

Click the save icon to keep the approver.
